site_selection_index_test: mucosa of the intended area
technique: Participants rinsed with solution B for 20 seconds; the intended mucosa was dried; solution A was applied; after 20 seconds participants rinsed again with solution B, stain intensity was noted, and cotton rolls were used to clear ambiguous staining.
positivity_threshold: The indicators of positive reaction include local, stipules and concentrated blue stains while wide and faint blue stains indicate a negative reaction.
positivity_threshold_transformed: positive: local, stippled or concentrated blue stain retention
comments_index_test: Biopsy was taken from the area with highest dye uptake after the index test, so the index test may have influenced reference standard site selection.

site_selection_index_test: Patients presenting with signs or symptoms suggestive of suspected oral malignancies; identified oral/oropharyngeal lesions were stained.
technique: Mouth rinsed with water for 20 s; 1% acetic acid applied for 20 s; 1% toluidine blue oral rinse for 20 s; 1% acetic acid rinse repeated; final water rinse.
positivity_threshold: Lesions that exhibited dark blue staining were deemed positive for premalignant or malignant tissue, while those with light staining or no color were considered negative.
comments_index_test: Concentration inconsistent: Methods describe 1% toluidine blue, but figures label Toluidine blue 0.1% solution.

site_selection_index_test: Biopsies were taken from the area with most clinical suspicion by inspection and palpation.
technique: Clinical examination by inspection and palpation assessed lesion location, size, local infiltration, oral hygiene, and cervical lymph node status.
positivity_threshold: Clinical suspicion of premalignant or malignant lesion.
positivity_threshold_transformed: positive: clinical suspicion of premalignant or malignant lesion
comments_index_test: Conventional clinical suspicion comparator arm without staining.

site_selection_index_test: Dye was applied over the oral lesion, covering approximately 2 cm margin all around the lesion.
technique: Mouth rinsed with water; 1% acetic acid rinse for 20 s; area dried; dye applied with cotton swab for 1 min covering approximately 2 cm margin; 1% acetic acid rinse for 1 min; dye uptake observed under proper light and exposure.
positivity_threshold: A stain was considered positive for malignancy if the lesion diffusely or partly stained dark blue (royal or navy blue), or had stippled appearance; all equivocal lesions were considered positively stained unless proved otherwise.
positivity_threshold_transformed: positive: dark blue or stippled stain
comments_index_test: Reference-standard pathologists were blinded to staining information, but index-test assessor blinding was not reported.

site_selection_index_test: Lesional and perilesional tissue
technique: Lesional and perilesional tissue was assessed for visual fluorescence retention (VFR) and visual fluorescence loss (VFL) when viewed through the velscopeVX handpiece.
positivity_threshold: visual fluorescence loss (VFL)
comments_index_test: NA

site_selection_index_test: An oral medicine specialist recorded clinical findings, took pictures of the lesions, and picked the areas to be examined.
technique: Lesion cleaned with 1% acetic acid on a cotton bud, toluidine blue applied with a different cotton tip for 30 s, excess removed with 1% acetic acid, then mouth rinsed.
positivity_threshold: A positive lesion was the one which color changed to blue, while a negative lesion was with no change.
blinding_index_test_examiner: Examiner recorded clinical findings; blinding to other clinical information was not reported.
comments_index_test: Toluidine blue diagnostic analysis appears to include patients/lesions from the group receiving both toluidine blue and vinegar; arms may overlap.

site_selection_index_test: An oral medicine specialist recorded clinical findings, took pictures of the lesions, and picked the areas to be examined.
technique: A gauze soaked with vinegar was applied to a clean and dry lesion for one minute; the researcher noted changes and photographed the lesion.
positivity_threshold: A positive finding was designated when a lesion changed to opaque white.
blinding_index_test_examiner: Examiner recorded clinical findings; blinding to other clinical information was not reported.
comments_index_test: Acetic acid diagnostic analysis appears to include patients/lesions from the group receiving both toluidine blue and vinegar; arms may overlap.

site_selection_index_test: An oral medicine specialist recorded clinical findings, took pictures of the lesions, and picked the areas to be examined.
technique: Vinegar was applied first, followed by toluidine blue; biopsy was performed at the area that turned opaque white and stained blue, or both noncoincident areas.
positivity_threshold: A positive finding was indicated for a lesion with color changed to both opaque white and blue, while a negative finding was a lesion not demonstrating these combined changes.

blinding_index_test_examiner: Examiner recorded clinical findings; blinding to other clinical information was not reported.
comments_index_test: Paper reports both 27 lesions receiving both substances and 28 specimens analyzed; noncoincident stained areas could receive biopsies at both areas.

positivity_threshold: Cytology was classified as negative (negative) and positive (doubtful, positive).

index_test_commercial_name: GEMINI Medical Diagnostic System's (Changsha) DNA Image Cytometer (DNA-ICM)

technique: Brush samples were examined using liquid-based thin-layer cell preparation and Feulgen staining, then scanned with the GEMINI Medical Diagnostic System's DNA Image Cytometer.
positivity_threshold: The oral specimen was classified as having abnormal DNA content if the aneuploid group had more than 3 nuclei (1% of at least 300 nuclei), or the hyperdiploid group had 5% of total nuclei, or the tetraploid group had 10% of total nuclei.
blinding_index_test_assessors: DNA image cytometry was performed blinded to the histological results.
comments_index_test: Same DNA-ICM index test was evaluated across OSF, OLK, and OSF+OLK patient groups; subgroup diagnostic accuracy was reported separately.

comments_index_test: Cell-block adequacy issue: 38 of 110 H&E-stained cell blocks were excluded for inadequate cellularity.

index_test_reagent_name: GOCCLES® device and toluidine blue (TB) staining

technique: Combined diagnostic performance used cases where GOCCLES® and TB staining results were concordant, either both positive or both negative.
positivity_threshold: Six cases tested positive for both techniques.
calibration_of_assessors: All biopsy procedures and the processes described above were performed by the same professional with specialized training in oral medicine.
blinding_index_test_assessors: Another limitation is the lack of examiner blinding, as all procedures including biopsy site selection were performed by the same professional.
blinding_index_test_examiner: Another limitation is the lack of examiner blinding, as all procedures including biopsy site selection were performed by the same professional.
comments_index_test: Combined diagnostic performance was evaluated only in the 18 concordant cases.

site_selection_index_test: oral cavity lesion or suspicious area
specimen_collection: The samples from the oral cavity lesion or suspicious area were collected by a cytology brush.
technique: Samples from the oral cavity lesion or suspicious area were collected by cytology brush; harvested material was transferred onto a glass slide; alcohol-fixed smears were stained according to the Papanicolaou method and interpreted by the cytopathologist.
positivity_threshold: positive for malignant cells
comments_index_test: NA

index_test_reagent_name: TP4303 solution (0.5 µg); 20 µl of 4,6 Dimidino-2-phenylindole, Dihydrochloride (DAPI, Fisher Scientific, PA)
site_selection_index_test: harvested material from the suspected lesion
specimen_collection: The samples from the oral cavity lesion or suspicious area were collected by a cytology brush.
technique: Glass slides with harvested material from the suspected lesion were fixed in 97% alcohol; TP4303 solution (0.5 µg) was added to cover the cell area; slides were kept in the dark at 22°C for approximately 20 minutes, rinsed with deionized water, and air dried; 20 µl DAPI was added, a coverslip placed, and slides observed using a fluorescent microscope.
positivity_threshold: positive for VPAC receptors (malignant cells)
comments_index_test: VPAC receptor fluorescence assay on brush cytology material, using TP4303 and DAPI.

index_test_reagent_name: TP4303 solution (0.5 µg); 20 µl of 4,6 Dimidino-2-phenylindole, Dihydrochloride (DAPI, Fisher Scientific, PA)
site_selection_index_test: cells shed in oral gargles
specimen_collection: Patients gargled with 20 cc of normal saline for a few minutes and spit the contents into a collecting cup.
technique: Patients gargled with 20 cc normal saline and spit into a collecting cup; collected fluid was centrifuged; sediment was transferred onto a glass slide and fixed in 97% alcohol; the remaining VPAC fluorescence procedure was as described for brush cytology.
positivity_threshold: positive for VPAC receptors (malignant cells)
comments_index_test: VPAC receptor fluorescence assay on oral gargle sediment, using TP4303 and DAPI.

site_selection_index_test: Clinically selected suspicious oral cavity lesions.
technique: After thorough clinical examination, the suspicious lesions were stained with Toludine blue.
positivity_threshold: Lesions that showed dark blue staining were considered positive for premalignant or malignant tissue; light staining or no colour was considered negative.
comments_index_test: Both index tests were administered to the same 44 patients; arms are paired/non-independent.

site_selection_index_test: Clinically selected suspicious oral cavity lesions.
technique: After detailed history and clinical examination, patients underwent zero degree endoscopic examination in white light, followed by NBI.
positivity_threshold: Altered or hypervascularity and increased capillaries (brown dots) suggested malignancy; uniform or normal vascularity ruled out malignant chances.
positivity_threshold_transformed: positive: altered vascularity with brown dots
comments_index_test: Both index tests were administered to the same 44 patients; arms are paired/non-independent.

site_selection_index_test: Applied to fixatives from biopsy specimens of included oral lesions: 15 OPMDs and 15 oral malignant lesions.
specimen_collection: Left over formalin of specimen bottles in which the biopsy specimens were received was used.
technique: Fixative fluid from the original specimen bottle was centrifuged at 3000 rpm for five minutes; supernatant was discarded, sediments washed twice in normal saline, smears prepared on albumen-coated slides, fixed and stained with PAP stain.
positivity_threshold: Negative was Class I; positive was Class II and III for OPMDs and Class IV and V for oral malignant lesions.
positivity_threshold_transformed: positive: cytology class II/III for OPMD; class IV/V for malignancy
comments_index_test: Index test was performed on leftover formalin from biopsy specimen bottles, not as a pre-biopsy in-vivo test.

site_selection_index_test: One oral lesion smear was taken from each patient before biopsy using a cytobrush all over the lesion.
specimen_collection: One oral lesion smear was taken from each patient before biopsy using a cytobrush all over the lesion.
technique: Slides were stained according to Papanicolaou and classified, applying an adaptation of Remmerbach et al.
positivity_threshold: Cytologic high-risk results indicated high-grade lesions suspicious for malignancy and squamous cell carcinoma samples.
comments_index_test: NA

site_selection_index_test: The DNA-ICM was performed on the same oral lesion smear taken before biopsy from all over the lesion.
specimen_collection: One oral lesion smear was taken from each patient before biopsy using a cytobrush all over the lesion.
technique: Slides were uncovered in xylene and stained by the Feulgen-Schiff method according to the manufacturer's instructions.
positivity_threshold: The sample was considered aneuploid if a stemline DNA index was <0.90 and >1.10 or <1.80 and >2.20 or <3.60 and >4.40 or if there were cells with exceeding 9c content.
comments_index_test: DNA image cytometry is not one of the prespecified harmonized oral-cancer index test types; classified as other.

site_selection_index_test: The combined test used the same oral lesion smear taken before biopsy from all over the lesion.
specimen_collection: One oral lesion smear was taken from each patient before biopsy using a cytobrush all over the lesion.
technique: Ploidy measurement using Feulgen stain was performed in the same smear previously stained by Papanicolaou for cytologic evaluation.
positivity_threshold: Both methods positive.
comments_index_test: Combined analysis appears to include concordant results only, reported as both negative and both positive.

site_selection_index_test: Suspicious oral mucosal lesions in the selected 250 patients were examined.
technique: Autofluorescence examination was performed using the Velscope.
positivity_threshold: Dark/ brownish color fluorescence observed through Velscope was considered as positive for dysplastic changes within the mucosa.
calibration_of_assessors: VELscope examination was performed by a dental surgeon/trained Field Investigator.
comments_index_test: FVI and mixed fluorescence patterns were treated as FVR/negative for analysis due to lack of specific criteria.

site_selection_index_test: Suspicious oral mucosal lesions in the selected 250 patients were examined.
technique: Conventional oral examination was done under white operatory light and a provisional clinical diagnosis was noted.
positivity_threshold: NR
calibration_of_assessors: Conventional oral examination was performed by trained field investigators.
comments_index_test: Twelve white-light cases had no result and were excluded from the 2×2 analysis.

site_selection_index_test: usual routine clinical examination according to the standard protocol; Roed-Petersen protocol was also completed
technique: Only white light examination was performed as the conventional oral examination.
positivity_threshold: CA was positive when a suspect lesion was seen
comments_index_test: Same 195 patients were assessed through clinical examination and VELscope; arms are not independent.

site_selection_index_test: the oral cavity was examined using VELscope
technique: The oral cavity was examined using VELscope and a Pentax reflex camera.
positivity_threshold: loss of fluorescence
comments_index_test: Same 195 patients were assessed through clinical examination and VELscope; arms are not independent.

site_selection_index_test: clinical examination plus oral cavity examination using VELscope
technique: Clinical examination was performed first; in addition, autofluorescent light examination was performed.
positivity_threshold: CA positive when a suspect lesion was seen; autofluorescence positive when loss of fluorescence was counted
positivity_threshold_transformed: positive: suspect lesion seen or fluorescence loss
comments_index_test: Same 195 patients were assessed through clinical examination and VELscope; arms are not independent.

site_selection_index_test: Oral tissue was examined with Identafi® to visualize the extent of the lesion.
technique: After conventional oral examination and dimming the lights, the instrument was switched to violet light to examine loss of autofluorescence; lesions displaying LOA were blanched.
positivity_threshold: Lesions that displayed LOA were considered to be positive and lesions that displayed no LOA or gain of autofluorescence were considered to be negative.
comments_index_test: Same patients/lesions received sequential Identafi® and toluidine blue; biopsy site selection considered LOA, toluidine blue positivity, and clinical judgment.

index_test_arm_label: Light-based test - Tissue reflectance (Identafi® green-amber light)
site_selection_index_test: Oral tissue was examined with Identafi® to visualize the extent of the lesion.
technique: After white and violet light examination, the light was switched to green-amber light to visualize differences in vasculature between normal and abnormal tissue.
positivity_threshold: Under green-amber light lesions with diffuse vascularity (appeared darker) were considered positive; lesions without visible vasculature or similar vasculature were negative.
positivity_threshold_transformed: positive: diffuse vascularity or darker appearance
comments_index_test: Same patients/lesions received sequential Identafi® and toluidine blue; biopsy site selection considered LOA, toluidine blue positivity, and clinical judgment.

site_selection_index_test: Toluidine blue solution was applied to the lesion with a cotton swab.
technique: Patients rinsed with water for 20 seconds; 1% acetic acid was applied for 20 seconds; the area was dried; 1% toluidine blue was applied with cotton swab for 1 minute; 1% acetic acid was applied for one minute; patients rinsed again with water.
positivity_threshold: Dark blue stain uptake was considered positive; light blue staining or absence of staining was negative.
comments_index_test: Same patients/lesions received sequential Identafi® and toluidine blue; biopsy site selection considered LOA, toluidine blue positivity, and clinical judgment.

index_test_arm_label: Vital Staining (2% Toluidine Blue-Containing Electrospun Fiber + 1% Acetic Acid)
index_test_reagent_name: electrospun containing 2% toluidine blue; 1% acetic acid
site_selection_index_test: Lesions from patients with suspected OPMDs and ulcerations suggestive of malignancy or nonhealing ulcers persisting for >2 weeks without any identifiable cause were included.
technique: 1% acetic acid was applied with a cotton tip for 20 s; a 2×2 cm electrospun patch containing 2% TB was applied for 20 s; 1% acetic acid was reapplied for 20 s to remove retained stain.
positivity_threshold: positive (dark blue staining); negative (pale/no staining)
comments_index_test: The developed TB-containing electrospun fibers were not compared with standard TB staining protocols.

site_selection_index_test: Applied to the lesion with a cotton swab; biopsy was taken from stained sites, and non-stained lesions were biopsied at clinically decided sites.
technique: Patients rinsed the mouth with water, received 1% acetic acid mouth wash for 20 seconds, then 1% toluidine blue was applied to the lesion with a cotton swab followed by acetic acid mouth wash to remove extra stain.
positivity_threshold: The staining is recorded as positive or negative irrespective of the intensity of the stain.
comments_index_test: NA

site_selection_index_test: Applied directly on the lesion.
technique: 1% MB applied directly on the lesion with cotton bud for 30 seconds after mouth rinse/drying; excess dye washed with 1% lactic acid and retention assessed.
positivity_threshold: Dark royal blue/deep blue stains of MB were considered as positive retention.
comments_index_test: Same participants underwent sequential staining; double-staining sequence was MB followed by LI.

index_test_arm_label: Vital Staining (5% Methylene Blue + 3% Lugol's Iodine)
site_selection_index_test: LI was applied to the lesional and perilesional sites after MB staining.
technique: After MB staining, 3% LI was applied to lesional and perilesional sites with a cotton bud for 10–20 seconds; double-stain pattern was interpreted.
positivity_threshold: Pale yellow or unstained areas (negative) were considered to be dysplastic.
positivity_threshold_transformed: positive: pale yellow or unstained after Lugol's iodine
comments_index_test: Double-staining sequence was MB followed by LI.

site_selection_index_test: All study participants with suspicious OPMDs underwent another oral examination using OralID®.
technique: Each subject had the oral cavity examined under conventional lighting and then with the fluorescence light-based handheld device OralID®; visible OPMDs were recorded.
positivity_threshold: Those with lack of fluorescence or dark, or a combination of bright green/white green fluorescent and dark areas were recorded as OPMDs.
positivity_threshold_transformed: positive: loss of fluorescence or dark areas
calibration_of_assessors: The dentist was highly trained in detecting OPMDs with the conventional oral examination; no autofluorescence-specific calibration was reported.
blinding_index_test_examiner: The same clinician performed the conventional examination and the fluorescence examination; blinding to prior clinical findings was not reported.
comments_index_test: Unit of analysis stated as oral lesion, but results table/text reports participant counts; lesion-level denominator not explicitly reported.

site_selection_index_test: oral lesions
technique: AA solution application to suspected lesions on the first day.
positivity_threshold: NR
calibration_of_assessors: The identification of lesion, application, and assessment of the lesion following vital staining were all standardised across all examiners in the study.
comments_index_test: All three stains were applied to the same subjects/lesions; arm results are not independent.

site_selection_index_test: oral lesions
technique: LIS application to suspected lesions on the first day.
positivity_threshold: NR
calibration_of_assessors: The identification of lesion, application, and assessment of the lesion following vital staining were all standardised across all examiners in the study.
comments_index_test: All three stains were applied to the same subjects/lesions; arm results are not independent.

site_selection_index_test: oral lesions
technique: The following day, the individuals were treated to TBS.
positivity_threshold: NR
calibration_of_assessors: The identification of lesion, application, and assessment of the lesion following vital staining were all standardised across all examiners in the study.
comments_index_test: All three stains were applied to the same subjects/lesions; arm results are not independent.

index_test_reagent_name: Velscope (LED Dental, Burnaby, British Columbia, Canada)
site_selection_index_test: A blue light (400–460 nm) was directed onto the oral tissues.
technique: Examinations were conducted in a dark room, with patients wearing special glasses provided in the Velscope kit; blue light (400–460 nm) was directed onto the oral tissues, and emitted fluorescence was assessed visually.
positivity_threshold: Lesions exhibiting loss of autofluorescence (FVL) appeared as dark areas, suggesting dysplasia.
calibration_of_assessors: Initially, 10 patients were examined to calibrate the visualization of colours for consistent assessment across the study.
comments_index_test: Small sample collected from a screening camp in one place; authors state results cannot be generalized.

index_test_reagent_name: handheld VELscope (C Ultra by Technomax Corporation, Pune, Maharashtra)
index_test_commercial_name: VELscope (C Ultra by Technomax Corporation, Pune, Maharashtra)
site_selection_index_test: Clinically suspicious oral lesions
technique: After COE, autofluorescence visualization (AFV) was achieved by a handheld VELscope.
positivity_threshold: AFL: Loss of fluorescence.
comments_index_test: NA

site_selection_index_test: Clinically diagnosed OL, OLP and OSMF lesions/suspicious lesions were examined.
technique: VELscope examination was performed from approximately 3–4 inches away, and tissue fluorescence was noted as fluorescence retention or loss.
positivity_threshold: Fluorescence loss was considered suspicious/positive; normal oral mucosa retains pale green fluorescence, while dysplasia/inflammation/increased vascularization lose fluorescence and appear dark.
comments_index_test: Same 30 participants underwent VELscope followed by vital stains; arms are not independent.

site_selection_index_test: Vital stain was applied on the suspicious area.
technique: After VELscope, vital staining procedures using toluidine blue were performed on the suspicious area; stain uptake/no uptake/light uptake was recorded and photographed.
positivity_threshold: A dark blue (royal or navy) stain of the entire lesion or a portion was considered positive.
comments_index_test: Same 30 participants underwent VELscope followed by vital stains; arms are not independent.

site_selection_index_test: Vital stain was applied on the suspicious area.
technique: After VELscope, vital staining procedures using methylene blue were performed on the suspicious area; stain uptake/no uptake/light uptake was recorded and photographed.
positivity_threshold: Deep blue stains that were local, stippled and patchy were considered positive; faint blue stains that were wide, shallow and easily washable were considered negative.
positivity_threshold_transformed: positive: deep blue local stippled patchy stain
comments_index_test: Same 30 participants underwent VELscope followed by vital stains; arms are not independent.

site_selection_index_test: Vital stain was applied on the suspicious area.
technique: After VELscope, vital staining procedures using Lugol's iodine were performed on the suspicious area; stain uptake/no uptake/light uptake was recorded and photographed.
positivity_threshold: Malignant/dysplastic tissues with reduced glycogen remain unstained, while normal epithelium stains brown or black.
comments_index_test: Lugol threshold may be ambiguous; Discussion describes malignant tissue as unstained despite general vital-stain Methods wording.

site_selection_index_test: Applied to white or red and white oral lesions suspicious of PMD.
technique: Five percent acetic acid was applied to the lesion with a sterile disposable cotton applicator for 60 seconds.
positivity_threshold: The acetic acid application was considered positive if the lesion appears opaque white (acetowhite).
comments_index_test: Acetic acid was performed before toluidine blue on the same lesion; comparison is paired rather than independent arms.

site_selection_index_test: Applied to white or red and white oral lesions suspicious of PMD.
technique: After acetic acid application, 1% toluidine blue was applied to the lesion with a sterile disposable cotton applicator for 60 seconds and decolorized with acetic acid.
positivity_threshold: The lesion was considered toluidine blue positive if it retained blue color after the staining.
comments_index_test: Toluidine blue was applied after acetic acid to the same lesion; test order may affect interpretation.

site_selection_index_test: Participants were screened for oral mucosal lesions, and those lesions were subjected to DrOroscope examination focusing on identifying dysplastic lesions.
technique: On blue light exposure, normal tissues reflect green fluorescence; loss of fluorescence in abnormal tissues makes areas appear dark.
positivity_threshold: Loss of fluorescence in abnormal tissues, due to which the areas appear dark.
calibration_of_assessors: The examiner was trained in the operation of DrOroscope and interpreting its results.
comments_index_test: NA

index_test_arm_label: Light-based test - Autofluorescence (IllumiScan® average fluorescence intensity)
index_test_reagent_name: IllumiScan® (Shoufu, Kyoto, Japan), 425 nm blue light
site_selection_index_test: Lesions were recorded under white light and photographed with IllumiScan® in a dark room.
technique: The lesions were recorded using a digital camera under white light and were then photographed using IllumiScan® in a dark room.
positivity_threshold: average FI cut-off of 98.5
comments_index_test: Cut-off values were defined based on the Youden index.

index_test_reagent_name: IllumiScan® (Shoufu, Kyoto, Japan), 425 nm blue light
site_selection_index_test: Lesions were recorded under white light and photographed with IllumiScan® in a dark room.
technique: The lesions were recorded using a digital camera under white light and were then photographed using IllumiScan® in a dark room.
positivity_threshold: SD cut-off of 11.2
comments_index_test: Cut-off values were defined based on the Youden index.

index_test_arm_label: Light-based test - Autofluorescence (IllumiScan® coefficient of variation)
index_test_reagent_name: IllumiScan® (Shoufu, Kyoto, Japan), 425 nm blue light
site_selection_index_test: Lesions were recorded under white light and photographed with IllumiScan® in a dark room.
technique: The lesions were recorded using a digital camera under white light and were then photographed using IllumiScan® in a dark room.
positivity_threshold: CV cut-off of 1.70
comments_index_test: Cut-off values were defined based on the Youden index.

site_selection_index_test: oral cavity
technique: Patients were examined via conventional VOE by experienced senior oral maxillofacial surgeons.
positivity_threshold: The VOE assessment of leukoplakia, erythro leukoplakia, erythroplakia, verrucous hyperplasia, and possibly oral cancer were identified as abnormal findings in this analysis.
comments_index_test: NA

site_selection_index_test: oral exfoliated cell specimen from the mucosal lesion
specimen_collection: Oral epithelial cells were collected using a foam brush and preserved in “Epigene” Specimen Collection and Transfer Tube.
technique: Extracted gDNA was bisulfite-converted; ZNF582m levels were determined using the “Epigene” ZNF582 DNA Detection Kit through quantitative methylation-specific PCR using TaqMan-based technology.
positivity_threshold: DNA methylation was qualitatively determined in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.
comments_index_test: Methylation marker test does not fit predefined vital staining, light-based, or cytology categories.

index_test_reagent_name: visual oral examination and ZNF582 methylation marker
site_selection_index_test: VOE of oral cavity; oral exfoliated cell specimen from the mucosal lesion for methylation testing
specimen_collection: Oral epithelial cells were collected using a foam brush and preserved in “Epigene” Specimen Collection and Transfer Tube.
technique: Sequential triage model combining abnormal VOE findings and methylation positivity; VOE was performed by experienced OMS and ZNF582m was assayed by quantitative methylation-specific PCR.
positivity_threshold: positive results based on visual oral examination and methylation positivity
positivity_threshold_transformed: positive: abnormal VOE and ZNF582 methylation positivity
comments_index_test: This is a statistical triage strategy rather than a separately randomized study arm; all patients had both VOE and ZNF582 methylation testing.

index_test_reagent_name: visual oral examination and ZNF582 methylation marker
site_selection_index_test: both VOE and ZNF582tm tests should be used in all patients with mucosal lesions
specimen_collection: Oral epithelial cells were collected using a foam brush and preserved in “Epigene” Specimen Collection and Transfer Tube.
technique: Parallel co-testing model including both VOE and methylation marker; VOE was performed by experienced OMS and ZNF582m was assayed by quantitative methylation-specific PCR.
positivity_threshold: NR
comments_index_test: This is a statistical co-testing strategy rather than a separately randomized study arm; no binary positivity threshold for the co-testing model was reported.

index_test_arm_label: Light-based test - Autofluorescence (Multispectral autofluorescence imaging endoscopy)
site_selection_index_test: Suspicious oral lesion and a clinically healthy-appearing area in the corresponding contralateral anatomical side.
technique: Autofluorescence endoscopic images were acquired with a 10 mm circular field-of-view, ∼100 μm lateral resolution, and <3 s acquisition time per multispectral image.
positivity_threshold: The validation sample was classified as cancer/precancer if its predicted image-level score was greater than or equal to the optimized threshold, or as benign otherwise.
positivity_threshold_transformed: positive: image-level score greater than or equal to optimized threshold
comments_index_test: Best-performing multispectral autofluorescence L1-SVM model used top four absolute spectral features; multiple feature pools and feature set sizes were evaluated on the same dataset.

index_test_reagent_name: combined normalized autofluorescence intensities at the 452 ± 22.5 nm and >500 nm emission bands (I452,n + I500,n)
site_selection_index_test: Clinically suspicious oral lesions from the same multispectral autofluorescence endoscopic image dataset.
technique: A linear L1-SVM model using a single spectral feature, I452,n + I500,n, simulated the VELscope autofluorescence emission and was trained/cross-validated using LOPOCV.
positivity_threshold: The validation sample was classified as cancer/precancer if its predicted image-level score was greater than or equal to the optimized threshold, or as benign otherwise.
positivity_threshold_transformed: positive: image-level score greater than or equal to optimized threshold
comments_index_test: This was a simulated VELscope comparison using multispectral autofluorescence data, not acquisition with the actual VELscope device.
